[i][font=Times New Roman][color=#d0e0e3]A brief introduction to the mod..[/color].[/font]
[/i]
[color=#a2c4c9]My mod changes Pam (an already clownish character) into a much more terrifying character based on Pennywise! Due to this new appearance of her, her dialogue has been modified a bit to fit her new personality![/color]

[color=#d9d2e9]﻿﻿﻿•❅──────✧❅✦❅✧──────❅•[/color]

[i][font=Times New Roman][color=#ead1dc]How do I install it?[/color][/font]

[/i][color=#d5a6bd]Just plop the mod into your mods folder and you're good to go! It requires you to use Content Patcher, though.[/color]

[color=#d9d2e9]﻿﻿﻿﻿•❅──────✧❅✦❅✧──────❅•[/color]
